subject: Marketplace renewal: rolling-window + split invoicing plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: lisa.wong@nimbuslabs.com, procurement@nimbuslabs.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace renewal: rolling-window + split invoicing plan

Hi Lisa / Nimbus procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive renewal discussion last week. Attached is a consolidated private-offer draft that covers both AWS and Azure marketplaces and a recommended rolling renewal window to align your consumption across regions while preserving predictable unit economics. Highlights: 

- Two private offers (AWS + Azure) under a single commitment umbrella so usage counts toward the same committed capacity.
- Rolling 12-month window (start-of-acceptance alignment) with the ability to ramp capacity mid-term (30-day notice).
- Split invoicing: EU usage billed monthly, US usage billed quarterly (you asked for flexibility here).
- Option for staged activation if you want to bring regions online independently.

Action items for Nimbus: please review the attached PDF (Redwood_Consolidated_Offer.pdf) and confirm whether procurement requires separate POs per cloud or a single PO referencing both private-offer IDs. Also let me know if legal wants redlines; we can prepare a consolidated SOW for signature and route to DocuSign.

If helpful, I can set a 30-minute call with Ben (marketplace billing) and Marissa (private-offer operations) to walk through the acceptance flow.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_Consolidated_Offer.pdf]

From: Lisa Wong <lisa.wong@nimbuslabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbuslabs.com, legal@nimbuslabs.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal: rolling-window + split invoicing plan

Monica — thanks for this. Quick questions from procurement and legal side: 

1) Invoice cadence: can you confirm month-by-month breakdown for EU and quarterly for US in the PO language? Our finance team needs clear invoice dates per region.
2) POs: we prefer to issue separate POs per marketplace (AWS / Azure) since our cloud teams allocate budgets separately. Is that acceptable?
3) Mid-term ramp: the approach sounds good; what is the notice window and how will additional units be billed/prorated?
4) Marketplace listing: does the acceptance still happen via the marketplace private-offer UI (recommended) or do we need a manual sign-off on your consolidated SOW first?

Attaching a quick PO template so you can see our internal fields (Nimbus_PO_Request.xlsx). Legal flagged a request that any DocuSign SOW include the final marketplace private-offer IDs so we can cross-reference.

Can we get written confirmation on the invoice cadence and PO approach by next Tue so procurement can schedule the PO?

Best,
Lisa Wong
Head of Platform Ops | Nimbus Labs
lisa.wong@nimbuslabs.com
[Attachment: Nimbus_PO_Request.xlsx]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus questions — need final billing language and acceptance path

Folks — forwarding Nimbus' procurement questions. Key asks: separate POs per cloud, explicit invoice cadence per region, and marketplace-private-offer IDs present on the SOW/DocuSign.

Notes / proposed approach (quick):
- Use a single commitment (our side) composed of two private offers (AWS + Azure). Nimbus issues two POs that reference each marketplace private-offer ID; we map both to the same internal commitment for usage aggregation.
- Invoice cadence: we can support monthly for EU and quarterly for US. Ben, will this require any special billing config on the marketplace side or can we translate via our billing pipeline?
- Mid-term ramp: propose 30-day written notice + prorated billing from the effective date of the additional tranche.
- Acceptance: recommend they accept via each marketplace UI so the clouds recognize the private-offer IDs; simultaneously sign a consolidated DocuSign SOW that lists both IDs for Nimbus' legal reference.

Attaching internal playbook notes to speed turnaround. Please flag any compliance or legal blockers.

Thanks,
Monica
[Attachment: internal_playbook_notes.md]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nimbus questions — need final billing language and acceptance path

Thanks — this approach is sound. A few implementation details to confirm before I send an official response to Nimbus: 

- Billing: we can map two private-offer IDs to a single commitment on our ledger and emit separate invoices using region tags. I will create two invoice templates: one monthly (EU) and one quarterly (US). No technical blocker on marketplace side; just need their PO numbers to tie to invoices.

- Proration: additional units will be prorated on a daily basis from the activation date of the add-on tranche. We should call this out clearly in the SOW.

- Acceptance flow: recommend they accept in each marketplace UI to trigger marketplace metadata. We'll include both IDs in the SOW and provide step-by-step acceptance instructions.

I'll draft the response language and attach the SOW template with placeholders for the marketplace IDs. Monica — if you can confirm the PO split preference we will finalize wording.

— Ben
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: lisa.wong@nimbuslabs.com, procurement@nimbuslabs.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal: rolling-window + split invoicing plan

Lisa — great questions. Confirmations below so procurement can proceed: 

- PO approach: Separate POs per marketplace (AWS and Azure) is fine. Please put the marketplace private-offer ID on each PO. We will map both to the same Redwood commitment (deal NIM-2026-PLAT-47) so usage aggregates.

- Invoice cadence: We will invoice EU usage monthly (invoice generation on the 1st of the month) and US usage quarterly (invoice generation on the 1st of each quarter). The invoice language will call this out and include region tags and the PO number for reconciliation.

- Mid-term ramp: 30 days written notice required. Additional capacity billed pro rata from the activation date of the extra tranche.

- Acceptance: please accept each private offer in the marketplace UI to bind the offer; simultaneously sign the consolidated SOW (I will send DocuSign link). The SOW will include both private-offer IDs and the PO numbers for Nimbus' records.

Next steps: once we receive your PO(s) we will:
1) Create the two private-offer objects (AWS + Azure) and return the IDs to you.
2) Route the SOW to DocuSign including both IDs so legal has a single signed artifact.
3) Trigger billing templates per the cadence above.

If procurement can send the POs by Tue EOD we can aim to have offers generated and the DocuSign envelope out the following business day.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_Answer_Doc.pdf]

- PO Azure: Nimbus-PO-12346 (attached separately; internal copy)

Procurement will confirm invoice remittance contacts after offers are active.

Regards,
